description.zh: WAF阶段，指定要查询的匹配引擎信息所处的WAF阶段。
description.en: Specifies the WAF phase from which to retrieve the matching engine information.

description.zh: 站点ID，可通过调用[ListSites](~~2850189~~)接口获取。
description.en: Specifies the ID of the site. You can get this ID by calling the [ListSites](~~2850189~~) operation.

description.zh: 取值目标，定义匹配引擎的应用目标。
description.en: Specifies the application target of the matching engine.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun esa get-waf-filter --site-id 1 --phase http_bot --target characteristics --type http_custom_cc --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun esa GetWafFilter --region cn-hangzhou --SiteId 1 --Target characteristics --Type http_custom_cc --Phase http_bot
